## Dispatch — `domain:ui` PM seat (`os-tesla`), round R24

Claimed: objectstack-ai/objectui#9150 — dispatched to an `os-dev` seat by the `domain:ui` PM seat (`os-tesla`) at R24.
Clause-②: yes

### Why `Clause-②: yes`

The repair changes what a **published** package renders for documents it already accepts: a `chart.title` authored as an inline locale map currently draws **no heading at all** and will start drawing one. That is a visible behaviour change on `@object-ui/plugin-report`, so a `no` declaration would hard-stop the seat at the edit the card exists for. ⇒ routes to contract review, which this seat performs.

### ⭐ The repair pattern is already in the same file — ⛔ do not invent one

Triage verified this on the tree and it is the whole shape of the round:

```
:927   const title = typeof chart.title === 'string' ? chart.title : undefined;   ← the defect
:96    import { …, useObjectTranslation, pickLocalized } from '@object-ui/i18n';
:782   return pickLocalized(label, language) || undefined;                         ← the correct form,
                                                                                      already in this file
```

`pickLocalized` is **the repo's one resolver** for the `I18nLabel` shape, the import is already present, and the file already documents it at `:770`. ⇒ this is converging one read site onto an in-file precedent, not introducing a mechanism.

### Acceptance

1. A `chart.title` authored as an inline locale map (e.g. `{ "zh-CN": "定价", "en": "Pricing" }`) must draw the heading, resolved for the active language.
2. ⭐ **Keep the plain-string case as the lit control** — it renders correctly today and must still render identically afterwards. If it moves, the repair overshot.
3. Cover the **language switch**: the same authored document under two languages must draw two different headings. A single-language assertion cannot distinguish `pickLocalized` from "picked the first key".
4. ⚠️ Include the case the narrowing currently swallows silently — a locale map with **no entry for the active language**. Say what it should do (fall back, or draw nothing) and pin it; ⛔ do not leave it to whatever `|| undefined` happens to produce.

### Scope

⛔ **Do not widen to the dashboard surface.** objectui#9038 / PR objectui#9149 scoped `title` to the dashboard and `subtitle`/`description` to both, deliberately; this card is the **report** surface's own `h3`. If you find a further read site outside `DatasetReportRenderer.tsx`, ⛔ name and file it, do not fix it here.

### Constraints

- Read `AGENTS.md` in full before your first edit.
- ⛔ `packages/components/src/ui/**/*.tsx` is a **No-Touch zone** (Commandment #7) — wrap in `packages/components/src/custom/` if you land there.
- ⛔ Never skip, disable or quarantine a test to get green. ⛔ Never force-push or rewrite pushed history.
- **Changeset required.** ⛔ Do not hand-pick a level by intuition: all 41 packages sit in ONE `fixed` group, so a split changeset cannot produce split levels and `major` is unavailable — this repo ships breaking as `minor` with a `**BREAKING**` carrier. ⚠️ A document that renders nothing today will start rendering a heading; weigh that in your level and justify it.
- ⚠️ There is **no npm script alias** `check:changeset-no-major` — `pnpm check:changeset-no-major` exits 254 `Command not found` = **NOT MEASURED, not a red gate**. The gate is real at `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` and runs via **`changeset:check`**.
- objectui has **no** `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`; derive the gate family by hand from `package.json` + `.github/workflows/`.
- ⚠️ **Your local package-scoped test run is not the blast radius.** Two PRs this round went red in CI on census/count pins that live in *other* packages precisely because they watch a call site across package boundaries. If your change moves a read site or a rendered node, run `examples/schema-catalog/` and grep for census pins that count what you changed, before pushing.
- ⚠️ If you need to dedup a finding: MCP `search_issues` is rate-limited on the MCP server's **own** identity and REST `/search/issues` is refused by the egress proxy. Paginate the REST issues list and carry a **known-hit control** so an empty result is a reading, not a dead channel.

### Report back

State explicitly: the before/after for the locale-map case and for the plain-string control; the two-language assertion and what would make it fail; what you decided for the missing-language case and why; which census pins you checked outside the package; and your changeset level with its justification.
